notes: Blocked on this check: consumerfinance.gov (CFPB), cdc.gov, ready.gov, foodsafety.gov and fsis.usda.gov returned 403 to automated reads, so nothing was taken from them. consumer.ftc.gov and ftc.gov returned 404. Not worked round; a person can open them in a browser and add links later. No open university course on household management exists in the sets checked (Open Yale Courses has none; MIT OpenCourseWare has building-science courses only), so the home area leans on public-domain books. Old books give wiring, gas, lead paint, asbestos, coal-stove and chemical advice that is dangerous today; flag every such line against a current EPA, CPSC or energy.gov source.
